review_notes: I read the whole file. It is made up of limit lemmas for rpow and exp, Complex cpow bounds, and IsBigO, IsLittleO and IsTheta lemmas for rpow and sqrt. None of these define a function or construction whose homomorphism, continuity, equivalence or action structure is left as loose facts. Each declaration is a Tendsto or asymptotic statement about an existing function, so the rubric has nothing to bundle. I checked ENNReal.tendsto_rpow_at_top and NNReal.tendsto_rpow_atTop as possible candidates. They are limit statements about the existing rpow, and the only consumer I found is Pow/Continuity.lean:459. I found no bundled object that is both a clear replacement and has a consumer that would improve, so I report nothing.
